chunks: Zurārah narrated from one of the two Imams, peace be upon them, who said:

If a man takes his young son for hajj, then he instructs him to recite the talbiyah and to enter into hajj. If he cannot recite the talbiyah properly, it is recited on his behalf, he is taken around for tawaf, and prayer is performed on his behalf.

I said: They do not have what they can slaughter on his behalf. He said: A sacrifice is slaughtered for the young children, while the older ones fast. They are to be guarded from what the muhrim must avoid of clothing and fragrance. If he kills game, then it is upon his father.

key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: one in the state of ihram
key_terms.صَغِيرٌ: a young child who has not reached maturity
key_terms.صَيْدًا: game animal hunted while in ihram
key_terms.يُصَلَّى عَنْهُ: prayer is performed on the child's behalf
key_terms.يُطَافُ بِهِ: the child is taken around for tawaf by another person
key_terms.يُلَبِّيَ: to recite the talbiyah for entering the rites of hajj

ai.seo_question: What are the rulings for performing hajj with a young child in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the fiqh of taking a young child for hajj and how a guardian facilitates the rites on the child's behalf when needed. It also outlines related rulings concerning talbiyah, tawaf, salat, sacrificial obligation, fasting, ihram restrictions, and liability for hunting.
